docs.title: Christus Redivivus, The Lord is risen. Being Some Account of Christ, what, and where he is; of the glory and mystery of his Person and Office, so miserably mangled now adaies. Wherein Also as in a glass may be seene the Image and proportion of all the waies and workes of God in the Kingdomes of the world. According to the measure of the light of things brought forth in Joshua Sprigge. ... (4 lines)
